title: Optimize static app for Vercel deployment
goal: Add minimal Vercel deployment configuration for the static Worksheet Universe app without adding framework dependencies or secrets.
context: The app is plain static HTML/CSS/JS and should remain openable by index.html. Vercel optimization should focus on safe static hosting defaults, security headers, clean URLs, and avoiding upload of harness runtime files.
acceptance: Vercel configuration exists for static deployment without adding framework dependencies
Vercel configuration does not commit project IDs, tokens, or .vercel/project.json
Security headers are configured for static routes
Non-hashed static assets use revalidation-safe cache headers
Vercel ignore rules exclude harness runtime noise from deployments
notes: Do not add accounts, auth, databases, serverless functions, or npm dependencies.
